title: 第173章 这价格比刚才正门那家假洋鬼子店还贵
slug: 让我开早餐店我下午才营业
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

一出天玺小区的正门，外面的热浪扑面而来。

大飞扶着马路牙子旁边的垃圾桶，直接干呕了两声。

小K一边收脚架，一边压低声音嘀咕，“飞哥，至于吗？里面啥味啊？”

“我特么……”

大飞眼角泛着泪花，回头看了一眼那块黑底金字的招牌，“预制菜我也吃过不少，没这么过分的！她哪怕多在微波炉里转个三十秒呢？我超了啊！”

“嘶……”

小K倒吸一口凉气，“我靠，里面的馅都是冷的？这老板心够大的。你刚才在里面硬吹建材和长相，我还以为你转行做房产中介了。”

“废话，钱都收了，我能当场砸人家场子吗？”

大飞从口袋里摸出一包烟，点上一根，深吸了一口气压压惊，“这店活不长。纯纯把客人当大冤种。走，赶紧找个地方吃点热乎的压一压，我这胃里现在还在冒凉气。”

小K安慰道，“飞哥，钱难挣屎难吃啊。”

“别提了。”

大飞摸了摸肚子苦着脸道，“走，赶紧找点热乎的东西往下压一压。搜搜这附近有没有什么正经面馆。”

小K掏出手机，

“有了。天玺小区侧门还有一家，叫范理早餐店。”

小K把手机屏幕递过去，“这名字够直接。看了下门面照片，没什么装修，红底黄字的招牌。连个宣传图都没有，评价倒是清一色的好评，就是说营业时间有点怪，下午才开门。”

大飞盯着屏幕看两秒，果断转身迈步。

“去看看。网红店骗骗外行还行。真正能在这片高档小区活下去的老店，绝对有点东西。”大飞凭借十年探店经验做出了判断。

两人顶着下午两点多的太阳，来到了天玺小区侧门。

还没走到门口，大飞的脚步突然顿住了。

顺风飘来一股味道。醇厚的肉香混合着面质特有的麦香，没有任何乱七八糟的香辛料冲鼻感，纯粹就是食材本身经过高温激发出的顶级原香。

大飞抽了抽鼻子，原本死气沉沉的眼睛瞬间爆出精光。

“小K，闻到没？”

“闻到了飞哥。这香气。”小K精神一振，拿着云台的手都稳了几分。

Page (1/3)

As soon as I walked out of the main entrance of Tianxi Community, the heat wave outside hit my face.

Da Fei held onto the trash can next to the curb and retched twice.

While retracting the tripod, Little K whispered in a low voice, "Brother Fei, what's the matter? What does it smell like inside?"

"What the hell..."

There were tears in the corners of Da Fei's eyes, and he looked back at the sign with gold letters on a black background, "I've eaten a lot of pre-made dishes, but nothing like this! Why did she even put it in the microwave for thirty seconds longer? I'm over the top!"

"Hiss..."

Little K took a breath of cold air, "Holy shit, the stuffing inside is all cold? This boss is so heartless. You just boasted about the building materials and appearance. I thought you had changed your career to a real estate agency."

"Nonsense, I've already collected the money, can I destroy someone else's business on the spot?"

Da Fei took out a pack of cigarettes from his pocket, lit one, and took a deep breath to calm down his shock, "This store won't last long. Chun Chun treats its customers as a big enemy. Let's go and find a place to eat something hot to calm down. I'm still feeling cold in my stomach."

Little K consoled him, "Brother Fei, it's hard to make money but hard to eat."

"Don't mention it."

Da Fei touched his stomach and said with a grimace, "Let's go, quickly find something hot to press down on. Check if there are any serious noodle restaurants nearby."

Little K took out his mobile phone,

"Yes. There is another one at the side entrance of Tianxi Community called Fanli Breakfast Shop."

Little K handed over the phone screen and said, "The name is straightforward enough. I looked at the photo of the storefront. There is no decoration, and there is a sign with yellow characters on a red background. There is not even a promotional picture, but the reviews are all positive, which means that the business hours are a bit strange, and it only opens in the afternoon."

Da Fei stared at the screen for two seconds, then decisively turned around and took a step forward.

"Go and have a look. It's okay for Internet celebrity stores to deceive laymen. An old store that can really survive in this high-end neighborhood definitely has something to offer." Da Fei made a judgment based on ten years of experience in visiting stores.

The two of them arrived at the side gate of Tianxi Community under the sun at around two o'clock in the afternoon.

Before he could reach the door, Da Fei's steps suddenly stopped.

A smell wafted down the wind.The mellow meat aroma is mixed with the unique wheat aroma of the dough, without any messy spices, it is purely the top original aroma stimulated by the high temperature of the ingredients themselves.

Da Fei sniffed, and his lifeless eyes instantly burst into light.

"Little K, do you smell it?"

"I smell Brother Fei. This fragrance." Little K was refreshed and his hand holding the gimbal became a little more steady.
